name: AddPathFollowerActiveEntry

name: SetPathFollowerMode

name: ResetPathFollower

evidence: takes a 0x10-byte entry from the world's pool at +0x1B08 and clears 16 bytes; its callers store it as an Attach03 link

name: ReleaseAttachRecords

name: AppendQueuedCallOnce
evidence: walks the list at +0x1EC8 and returns if a record with the same four words exists, otherwise calls AppendQueuedCall

evidence: takes a call record, stores its four words, and appends it to the world's list at +0x1EC8 (tail at +0x1ECC)

name: RemoveQueuedCalls
evidence: unlinks every record of the list at +0x1EC8 whose words match the ones selected by the bit mask (bits 1, 2, 4, 8 for words 0..3) and releases them

name: RunQueuedCalls
evidence: slot of the world: pops each record of the list at +0x1EC8, calls its function with the next three words, and releases it with ReleaseCallRecords

name: RunDueDelayedScriptCalls
evidence: UpdateWorld calls it with the time step: takes it off the delay of each (delay, expression) entry of the world's script variable +0x1EF8 (the list func_00117668 appends to), evaluates the expressions that fall due and drops their entries from the list

name: AllocateTouchNode
evidence: takes a record from the pool at world + 0x1C0C (func_001B5EC0) and clears its 8 bytes

name: FreeTouchNodes
evidence: walks a Touch03 chain by next and gives each node back to the pool at owner + 0x1C0C with func_001B5F28

name: PushCloneBatch
evidence: makes n - 1 copies of src with func_00183058 into a new buffer and pushes the (count, buffer) pair on the stack at 0x1F00 indexed by 0x1EFC

name: PopSpawnedClone
evidence: decrements the count of the stack entry at index in the array at 0x1F00 and returns the value it then points to

name: GatherCollidersInBox
evidence: allocates an array of the world's body count (+0x34) in back memory and fills it with the bodies of the world's list (+0x6C) and their parts whose bounds (+0x420 to +0x434) overlap the box of two points, skipping the given object, flagged bodies (+0x538 bits) and those the optional filter refuses; writes the array and its count; eighteen functions call it, among them ScoreTargetCandidate, BuildAgentPath and AddTargetObstructionCost

name: GatherCollidersInSphere

name: UnlinkContactTable

name: InitContactTables

name: PushContactTable
evidence: pushes node on the front of the doubly linked list *head (next, prev)

name: TakeContactTable

name: ReleaseContactTable

name: CreateConeVolumes

name: SkipBufferedBlocks

name: DrawProjectedCurve
